## How you know it is right

## Checklist

- [ ] One subject. If this is three unrelated fixes, it is fine — say so above.
- [ ] Front matter untouched, or `updated:` bumped if I re-checked the page's facts.
- [ ] No raw HTML (the site strips it).
- [ ] Internal links use the relative `.md` path.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (CI runs the same three checks).

<!-- Reminder: nothing is auto-merged. A human reads this. Factual corrections are merged
     fast; changes of style or structure get a conversation first — that is not a brush-off,
